reason: With 8 chairs and a register I can't see from outside, the drawer-cash check, cancelled bills and per-stylist earnings alone are worth ₹999 a month to me, and an app with my own logo makes the salon look modern. ₹4,999 setup with training at the salon is fine if the first month really is free.
objection: Who will help me when the app stops working on a busy Sunday or in Diwali week with a full waiting area? If billing freezes then, I lose money and my staff go straight back to the notebook.
would_change_my_mind: If they can't promise same-day phone or WhatsApp support on Sundays and festival days, or there is no way to keep billing offline when the internet drops, I would not continue after the free month.
